messages:
sam_w: quick follow-up from the onboarding rfc — i sketched a lightweight event contract for prober -> bench ingestor and a small gate API. want to validate assumptions about cardinality and how we treat flaky signals.

maria_k: drop it here pls. we should get prometheus-safe metrics + full event stream for debug.

sam_w: pasted below (rough):
```json
{
  \"model_id\": \"string\",
  \"probe_name\": \"string\",
  \"ts\": \"iso8601\",
  \"status\": \"ok|fail|warn\",
  \"short_code\": \"string\", // short taxonomy, e.g. \"kv_mismatch\", \"decode_err\"
  \"severity\": \"low|med|high\",
  \"input_id\": \"opt string\",
  \"evidence_path\": \"opt s3://... or url\",
  \"fingerprint_v2\": \"sha256 hex\"
}
```

jon_b: fingerprint_v2 is good. question: do we expect short_code to be canonical from producer, or should we rely on an ingest mapping?

diane_r: ingest mapping is useful but expensive. proposal: producers should emit canonical short_code when possible. ingestor runs a mapping fallback pass that tags events with canonical_code if mapping exists. keep mapping version in bench metadata.

maria_k: prometheus guidance: don't label by model_id or short_code. metrics we expose: `redwood_onboard_probe_count_total{status=\"fail\"}` and `redwood_onboard_probe_run_seconds` histogram. labels: status, region, run_env. no model/probe labels.

sam_w: agreed. full event topic will carry full payload for post-hoc analysis and forensic. topic: `onboard.probe.events.v2` (protobuf).

jon_b: protobuf makes sense. i'll draft proto with the fields above and a nested one for trace_excerpt (max 4kb) rather than large blobs. evidence_path stays separate.

maria_k: gating semantics: gate should consume an aggregated verdict for a model-version. recommended verdicts: PASS | REVIEW | REJECT. REVIEW = manual triage. expose top-3 canonical_code reasons and a link to sampled evidence.

sam_w: implementation detail: bench ingestor will do sliding-window aggregation (default window=15m) and count distinct fingerprints. only count unique fingerprints per input_id to avoid dupes. threshold default: >=2 distinct fingerprints with REJECT-worthy codes -> REJECT.

diane_r: add exponential backoff for transient infra errors: treat OOM/infra failures as noisy until we see persistent counts across windows. document the failure classes.

prober-bot: automated note — bench-prober v0.3.1 rolled to staging, emitted 5 fails on rmx-13b smoke set. report: https://ci.internal/reports/4770023344/prober-summary

maria_k: can bench attach a small deterministic signature for each failure so frontends can cheaply dedupe? fingerprint_v2 already covers that, but ensure it's stable across client languages.

jon_b: will standardize fingerprint impl in rust/go/python lib. spec: sha256(model_id + probe_name + short_code + first_128_chars(trace_excerpt)). hex lowercase.

sam_w: a couple of policy bits: 1) if evidence_path absent -> REVIEW not REJECT. 2) gate should prefer PASS if evidence contradicts metric-only trends. 3) mapping updates are versioned and recorded in model onboarding metadata.

diane_r: ops note: avoid high cardinality in dashboards. use event-stream for drilldowns. bench ingestor should emit aggregated daily histograms by model family for capacity planning.

maria_k: action items:
- sam_w: author short RFC update with canonical event example + gate API shape (due Thu)
- jon_b: proto + lib implementations for fingerprint (POC by Fri)
- diane_r: implement sliding-window dedupe + threshold logic in bench ingestor (PR next week)
- infra: provision `onboard.probe.events.v2` topic and retention 7d.

sam_w: cool. i'll post RFC link on the original thread. if anyone objects to defaults (window/threshold/labels) shout now.

prober-bot: notice: deploy time 2026-03-20T15:45Z for bench-prober v0.3.1

maria_k: thanks all, keeping this small and actionable helps. we'll iterate once we have proto + sample events. :rocket:
